Laura / team,

Quick legal note on signatory verification and artifacts:

1) Signatory authority:
- If the CFO is the signer, we do not require a board resolution in most cases.
- If the listed signer is not in a senior finance/executive role, ask for a POA or a single‑page board cert confirming delegation.

2) DocuSign envelope sequencing & fields:
- Recommended routing: Archimedes CFO -> Redwood VP Sales (signature) -> Redwood Legal (signature if required by contract threshold).
- Use sequential signing to ensure clear timestamps. Do not use embedded signing unless both sides agree.
- Include a mandatory text field for signatory title and email address to reduce ambiguity.

3) Audit bundle (what Redwood will include):
- DocuSign Certificate of Completion (PDF)
- Signed document PDF with embedded signature metadata (shows signer name, email, timestamp)
- Envelope ID and summary export (CSV) with IP addresses and UTC timestamps
- Final clean copy placed in HubSpot deal record and S3 archive (retention per customer agreement)

4) Naming & handoff:
- Envelope subject: "ACME Health — MSA Execution — {deal_id}"
- Attach the evidence-checklist-template.xlsx to the envelope for your internal records (optional).

If Archimedes wants Redwood to accept an electronically scanned POA, that is fine provided the signer name+title match the POA. Otherwise a short board cert is acceptable.

Jonas Weber
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
----- End forwarded message -----

Marissa — can you draft the envelope instructions and include the evidence checklist? I’ve attached a one‑page instruction template (evidence-checklist-template.xlsx) and a brief envelope-instructions.txt you can adapt.
